title: ajax pseudonarcissus var. telamonius
intro: Ajax pseudonarcissus var. telamonius, commonly known as Daffodil, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, soothe digestive issues, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Daffodil include its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit antitumor activity, and show promise in the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. The bioactive constituents of Daffodil include galantamine, lycorine, and other alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
